what: Trane Technologies makes heating, ventilation and air conditioning systems for commercial buildings and homes under the Trane brand, and refrigeration units for lorries and shipping containers under Thermo King.
customers: Owners and operators of commercial buildings, schools, hospitals and data centres; homeowners; food transport and cold chain operators.
money: commercial and residential HVAC and transport refrigeration in North and South America
HVAC and Thermo King in Europe, the Middle East and Africa
HVAC and transport refrigeration in Asia
moat: An installed base of equipment that needs servicing and parts for fifteen to twenty years, sold through a dealer network that is hard to replicate.
risks: Commercial construction follows the economic cycle
Residential HVAC demand depends on housing activity and weather
Transport refrigeration tracks the weak freight market
opportunities: Data centre cooling is a fast-growing, high-value application for commercial HVAC
Service revenue on the installed base grows steadily and carries higher margins
Return on invested capital above 20% is unusual for an industrial manufacturer
watch: Commercial HVAC bookings in the Americas and the size of the service backlog.
